# Stats

```tsx
import { Stats, statsValueVariants } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

A key number with its label, change and context. Mirrors the Figma Stats: Size (Small / Medium / Large) sets the value's Heading style (Medium / Large / X-Large); Show Label, Show Info Icon, Show Trend (with Negative) and Show Description are props. The Info icon opens `info` in a Tooltip.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Stats
  size={args.size}
  label={args.showLabel ? args.label : undefined}
  info={args.showInfo ? args.info : undefined}
  value={args.value}
  trend={args.showTrend ? args.trend : undefined}
  trendValue={args.trendValue}
  description={args.showDescription ? args.description : undefined}
/>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Stats component: Size (Small / Medium / Large) sets the value's Heading style; the rest is the same in every size.
- Label: Label/Small in Text/Primary, with the 16px Info icon (Icon/Primary) 8px after it.
- Value: Text/Primary, with the .Stats Trend 8px after it.
- Description: Body/Small in Text/Secondary.
- The rows are 4px apart.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`StatsProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Value: the number, in the Heading style of the size. |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Label: Label/Small in Text/Primary. |
| `info?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Info Icon: the tooltip text. Shows the Info icon after the label, which opens it on hover and focus. |
| `description?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Show Description: Body/Small in Text/Secondary. |
| `trend?` | `ListItemTrend` | Figma Show Trend: the direction (Figma Negative=False / True). |
| `trendValue?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma Trend Value: the change next to the trend icon, e.g. "12%". |

## Rules

- Import `Stats` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
